items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I used to do something in the Colonnade with Rick Henderson. He had a little nine-piece band, where occasionally we would go down there and play for a dance or something.

ctx.x: Was this after Leo came back?

Yeah, it’s after Leo came back. Was a lot of good things happening around here. Between the time I started to play and the time I left, I did a lot of good things. Worked with Rick Henderson. Rick Henderson was about my age, but he was way far ahead in music than I was, because he was a good alto player and he could make arrangements.
